queries.query: When must a company prepare a PBR Actuarial Report under VM-31?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 2.A annual PBR Actuarial Report preparation and applicability language.

queries.query: Under VM-31, must the PBR Actuarial Report consist of an Executive Summary, Life Summary, Life Report, Annuity Summary, and Annuity Report?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 2.A report-component and sub-report language.

queries.query: When must the VM-31 summaries and full PBR Actuarial Report be submitted to the domiciliary commissioner?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 2.C April 1 and within-30-days submission timing.

queries.query: How long does VM-31 require the company to retain supporting documentation, and what must it allow reviewers to determine?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 2.D seven-year retention and reproducibility requirement.

queries.query: How does VM-31 handle report-order headers and inapplicable Life or Annuity sections?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 3.A order, applicability, retained headers, and explanatory-statement language.

queries.query: What qualified-actuary information must the VM-31 Executive Summary identify?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 3.B.1 qualified-actuary paragraph.

queries.query: What assumption and margin documentation does VM-31 require in the Life Report?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 3.D.1 tables, changes, experience studies, and assumption-development documentation.

queries.query: What mortality segments, company experience, credibility, improvement, and prudent-estimate material must the VM-31 Life Report document?
queries.expectedEvidence: Complete Section 3.D.3 mortality requirement with its nested provisions.

queries.query: What exclusion-test information does VM-31 require the Life Report to provide for VM-20?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 3.D.10 VM-20 exclusion-test reporting requirements.

queries.query: Which investment, actuarial, and management certifications are required in the VM-31 Life Report?
queries.expectedEvidence: Complete Section 3.D.14 Life Report certification list.

queries.query: What does the VM-31 Life Summary require for Part 1 of the VM-20 Reserves Supplement?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 3.C.8 required supplement copy.

queries.query: What cash-flow model systems, segments, validation, and projection-period information must the VM-31 Annuity Report document?
queries.expectedEvidence: Complete Section 3.F.2 annuity cash-flow model requirement.

queries.query: What hedging strategy, CDHS, model-result, error-factor, and back-testing information does VM-31 require in the Annuity Report?
queries.expectedEvidence: Complete Section 3.F.8 hedging and risk-management requirement.

queries.query: What single-scenario and stochastic-exclusion information does VM-31 require for VM-22 business?
queries.expectedEvidence: Complete Section 3.F.13 VM-22 exclusion-test reporting requirement.

queries.query: What Alternative Methodology grouping, assumptions, contract features, and exclusion-test documentation does VM-31 require for VM-21?
queries.expectedEvidence: Complete Section 3.F.12 Alternative Methodology requirement.

queries.query: Under what conditions may VM-31 reporting exclude a portion of an NGE, and what must be disclosed if it is excluded?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 3.D.9 conditional-exclusion language and disclosures.

queries.query: How must the Life Summary explain material differences in methods, assumptions, or risk management between sub-reports?
queries.expectedEvidence: Section 3.C.6 Life sub-report consistency requirement, distinct from Annuity Summary 3.E.6.

queries.query: Under current 2026 VM-31, when shall the Executive Summary, Life Summary, and Annuity Summary be submitted?
queries.expectedEvidence: Current authoritative Section 2.C submission timing.

queries.query: What does VM-31 require the report to document about the VM-20 premium deficiency reserve methodology?
queries.expectedEvidence: No VM-31 provision in the current chapter establishes the requested premium-deficiency-reserve reporting requirement; related VM-20 methodology is not sufficient.

queries.query: What cryptoasset stress-test exhibit does VM-31 require?
queries.expectedEvidence: No source provision contains the requested cryptoasset requirement.

queries.query: What qualified-actuary certification does VM-31 require?
queries.expectedEvidence: The question is underspecified because VM-31 contains separate Life and Annuity certification provisions as well as test-method certification requirements.
